title: Detention
question: What does Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 section 230 say about detention?
shortAnswer: Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 s.230 — Detain persons arrested for customs offences; bring before court within 24h or release on bail.
legalExplanation:
**Section 230 of the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023** provides:

Detain persons arrested for customs offences; bring before court within 24h or release on bail

This provision empowers Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
